data.name: Regeneration Engine
data.detailed_description:
COMPELLING NARRATIVE

Set in an underground dungeon imminently after the end of the world, REGENERATION ENGINE explores the story of five characters unfortunate enough to fall down a well before they could be swept away by a powerful explosion. Unable to climb back out, unsure of if it’s worth the trouble, and unwilling to trust one another, they descend deeper into the ENGINE in hopes of finding out if there’s still a surface-world to return to.

REWARDING GAMEPLAY

REGENERATION ENGINE is a turn-based RPG that’s split between overworld exploration, battles, and inventory management. To proceed deeper into the engine, you must navigate through overworld puzzles, collect materials to survive, and find the line to victory in each battle. When characters fall, they’re dead for good and the surviving characters can receive a single-use power-up based on their skills.

TURN-BASED COMBAT

While combat is traditional turn-based fare, REGENERATION ENGINE is a puzzle stretched out across levels of encounters that require the player to experiment and augment their characters to survive each encounter. With so many combinations, players can expect to explore different character builds across runs.

ADAPTIVE STORY

As the party delves further and loses members to the monsters below, the characters’ relationships shift in real time as the only thing left to rely on is each other. Characters consume each other time and time again. Their interactions develop based on surviving characters and their desire to find what’s at the bottom of the ENGINE.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Multiple narratives

  • Adaptive dialogue

  • Turn-based battle

  • Character skill merging

  • Checkpoint-based save-load system

data.short_description: Fall into the ENGINE and try to fight your way back up to the surface in this turn-based RPG. As your companions die, consume their essences to grow stronger. Explore a strange underground world with your party, battle creatures roaming the dark, and discover the mystery behind the apocalypse.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU (Intel i3 or AMD Athlon) @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or AMD Radeon Vega 3)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10/11
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU @ 3.0 GHz (Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10.12 (x86_64) / 11.00 (arm64)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i3 @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 integrated / Intel HD 6000
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 13.0
  • Processor: Apple M2 or Intel Core i5 @ 3.0 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M2 integrated / AMD Radeon Pro 5300M / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (note: NVIDIA support on macOS was dropped after Mojave, so this only applies to older Intel Macs)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 / equivalent
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU (Intel i3 or AMD Athlon) @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics (Intel HD 4000 or AMD Radeon Vega 3)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 / equivalent
  • Processor: Quad-core CPU @ 3.0 GHz (Intel Core i5 / AMD Ryzen 5)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
